Similar questions have haunted 77-year-old Christine, who was discovered in a Waterloo train carriage. But she has more reason than many other foundlings to understand why a mother might give up a child. Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell host

programme.desc: 1953. Crime drama. Director: Francis Searle. Starring Dennis Price, Philip Saville and Peggy Evans. A serial killer on the loose makes a habit of murdering women on the street at precisely 3am.

programme.title: Anthony Perkins...

programme.title: Guilty?

programme.title: The First of the Few
